Choose panels for a layout

Source: R/layout.R
panel.Rd

panel() picks panels by the levels of panel dimensions, for the hero and side arguments of layout_hero().

Usage

panel(...)

Arguments

...

Name-value pairs of panel dimensions and levels, e.g. channel = "merge", view = "crop" or channel = c("GFP", "DAPI"). The order of the levels sets the order of the panels.

Value

A panel specification.

Examples

panel(channel = "merge", view = "crop")
#> $channel
#> [1] "merge"
#> 
#> $view
#> [1] "crop"
#> 
#> attr(,"class")
#> [1] "tidymontage_panel"
